a1eeca2d-8f52-4245-9e7b-07de4d23aa73.title: The Destroyer Fell in Love with Me
a1eeca2d-8f52-4245-9e7b-07de4d23aa73.altTitle: The Younger Male Lead Fell for Me Before the Destruction
a1eeca2d-8f52-4245-9e7b-07de4d23aa73.description: Keluar dari satu kesalahan meletuskan kisah asmara yang menarik dan intens! Sehari setelah akhirnya melunasi semua hutang mahasiswanya, Amelia bangun dan menyadari bahwa dia telah diteleportasi ke dalam novel yang dia sukai... Tetapi sebagai putri seorang bangsawan yang memiliki sejumlah hutang yang jika ingin dilunasi, maka orang itu harus bekerja selama sisa hidupnya. Dia menuju ke sebuah bar untuk minum demi meredam kesedihannya, namun akhirnya malah mabuk dan menghabiskan malam dengan Duke Kyle, seorang pria penghancur. Amelia mencoba untuk menjauh dari Duke dan reputasinya yang terkenal… Tapi apakah Amelia bisa mengubah nasib dan memberikan kisah yang berakhir bahagia?

6729edf9-82de-4a96-a3d4-80c72253c7dc.title: Cheol i Eopseoseo Geurae
6729edf9-82de-4a96-a3d4-80c72253c7dc.description: Yoo Hajin, who works as a private tutor for extra income, has a student: Im Ildo, a wealthy student preparing to retake his college entrance exams. However, one day, she hears shocking news from her younger sister. "Sis, Ildo is... my junior at university!" It turns out that Ildo, whom she thought was a struggling repeat student, had already been accepted into National University. From the day his true identity is revealed, Ildo’s meticulous schemes and terrifying obsession begin to slowly tighten their grip on Hajin's life.

e3e2c204-ccc4-4061-b9e0-526a8b47d652.title: Kominka Gyaru to Renovation Gurashi
e3e2c204-ccc4-4061-b9e0-526a8b47d652.description:
“Let’s make a warm home!” A renovation × romance drama about building a beloved home together with a gyaru.

Kazukage is suddenly presented with a divorce, accused of domestic violence he has no recollection of, and loses the home he could return to. At that moment, a cheerful gyaru calls out to him, “You can stay at my place.” She turns out to be Karen, his childhood friend who used to play “secret base” together with him when they were kids.

However, the house Karen leads him to is an old traditional house with years of wear—nothing like what one would expect from a gyaru.

While renovating the old house, the two gradually repair their wounded hearts and their relationship, rebuilding them anew.

Just like the secret base they once had.

16331353-8436-47b1-8783-d195eda1d2c7.title: Happy Face: From Slave to Arena Legend
16331353-8436-47b1-8783-d195eda1d2c7.description:
Born and raised as a slave in the arena, Happy survived by relying on nothing but his monstrous strength. When his master is executed and the arena collapses, Happy is finally freed for the first time in his life. Now, stepping into a world he barely understands, he begins to learn about family, friendship, and society— one painful, awkward step at a time.

But the world refuses to let him rest. His identity as a former slave The endless wars against crime The buried secrets of his birth. All of them drag Happy into new battles, each more brutal than the last. Through it all, he grows— beyond a mere fighter, beyond a monster— rising until he stands at the very pinnacle of the world.

From the bloodstained sands of the arena to the peak of power, this is the story of the boy who never forgot how to smile.
